text: Beds are oriented east-west so sunlight reaches the crop evenly, or along the slope direction if the field is sloped, to help rainwater drain off. Typical bed spacing is about 1.5 m between bed centers with a bed height of roughly 20-30 cm (dry season) or 30-35 cm (rainy season, higher to prevent waterlogging and root rot). Basal fertilizer worked into the bed before mulching: composted manure ~0.5 kg per m² (500 kg per 1,000 m²), N-P-K (20-20-15+TE) ~20 g per m² (20 kg per 1,000 m²), and lime ~32 g per m² (32 kg per 1,000 m²), mixed into the soil and watered in before laying plastic mulch.
